_about: What the web site and the web flasher show for this radio (docs/dev/website.md). Hardware facts stay in docs/spec.
name: Radioddity GD-88

bootloader: Turn the radio off and connect the programming cable.
Hold P2 and turn the radio on with the volume knob. When the LED lights red and the top line shows IAP_A or IAP_B, release P2. It can take more than one try.
If the top line shows IAP_B, hold P2 until it shows IAP_A.
second_bootloader: Turn the radio off and connect the programming cable.
Hold P2 and turn the radio on with the volume knob. When the LED lights red and the top line shows IAP_A or IAP_B, release P2. It can take more than one try.
If the top line shows IAP_A, hold P2 until it shows IAP_B.
